description: A secret API key for the developer's own server (Toolaby's REST API, Test), written into an env file as TOOLABY_API_KEY, with the API's base for this side as TOOLABY_API_URL, and never shown: the answer says where it went, not what it is. The file is created if missing; a TOOLABY_API_KEY line already there is replaced. Make sure the file is in .gitignore.

envFile.description: The env file, like ".env" (relative to where the server started) or an absolute path.

name.description: Optional: what the key is for, like "Server".

workspace.description: The workspace slug, when you have more than one (toolaby_whoami lists them).

name: toolaby_create_api_key
title: Make a server API key
